### 3. Alternators & Starters (Specialty)
- High-output alternators (90A–300A+), starter motors, LIN-bus smart voltage regulators, overrunning decoupler pulleys (OAP/OAD), and 24V commercial starters.

### 4. Brakes & Friction
- Ceramic low-dust pads, semi-metallic pads, rust-inhibiting coated disc rotors, brake calipers, master cylinders, brake hoses, and ABS sensors.

### 5. Suspension & Steering
- Complete pre-assembled quick-strut assemblies, gas shock absorbers, forged control arms with pre-pressed ball joints, tie rod ends, sway bar links, and electric power steering (EPS) racks.

### 6. Air Conditioning & Climate Control
- Brand-new AC compressors, aluminum micro-channel condensers, evaporators, expansion valves, receiver-driers, and HVAC cabin blower motors.

### 7. Commercial & Heavy Truck Parts
- 24V brushless alternators, diesel gear-reduction starters, air brake chambers (Type 30/30), cast iron drums, slack adjusters, and multi-leaf spring packs.

### 8. Engines & Powertrain
- Complete tested replacement engines, cylinder heads, master timing chain kits, water pumps, oil pumps, and heavy-duty CV half-shaft axles.

### 9. Headlights & Automotive Lighting
- DOT/SAE compliant LED projector headlights, Bi-Xenon housings, tail light clusters, bumper fog lamps, and sequential turn signals.
